product_overview: A feature-based document editor web app with authentication, role-based access, an admin dashboard, and a rich text editing workspace. Users can log in, recover access, manage users as an admin, and work in a modular editor environment.
core_goals: Sign in with workspace, email, and password credentials
Recover access through password reset flows
Let admins view dashboard information and manage users
Provide a rich text document editing workspace for authorized users

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allows users to authenticate with workspace, email, and password, then enter the app based on their role.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in workspace -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See dashboard or editor based on role
Navigate to /login -> Leave required fields empty or enter invalid values -> Submit login form -> See validation error messages
Navigate to /login -> Fill in workspace -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Toggle password visibility -> Submit login form -> See the signed-in destination
Navigate to /login -> Select forgot password option -> Navigate to /forgot-password

features.name: Forgot Password
features.description: Lets users request a password reset link by providing their email address.
user_flows: Navigate to /forgot-password -> Fill in email -> Submit reset link request -> See success message
Navigate to /forgot-password -> Fill in email -> Submit reset link request -> See error message

features.name: Reset Password
features.description: Lets users set a new password using the reset password page.
user_flows: Navigate to /reset-password -> Fill in new password -> Fill in confirm password -> Submit reset password form -> See success message
Navigate to /reset-password -> Fill in new password -> Fill in confirm password -> Submit reset password form -> See error message

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Provides admins with a dashboard home page for overview and navigation.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View dashboard overview -> Navigate to user management page

features.name: User Management
features.description: Allows admins to view the application user list and refine it with search or filtering.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/users -> View list of users -> Search or filter users

features.name: Document Editor
features.description: Provides an authenticated document editing workspace with formatting, panels, ruler, profile, and document actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /editor -> View document workspace -> Type and edit text in the document workspace -> Use toolbar to format text -> View document ruler -> Open user profile in the header -> Access header actions such as save, share, or export
Navigate to /editor -> View document workspace -> Resize panels using drag handles -> Navigate sidebar icons to switch panels -> View the updated editor panels
Navigate to /editor -> Open chart context menu on figures -> View figure or chart options

routes.description: Root redirector - sends user to login or dashboard based on auth state and role
User login page with workspace, email, and password fields
Admin dashboard home page (Admin role only)
Main rich-text document editor page (Admin and Author roles)
